items.title: How Agentic AI Can Boost Cyber Defense
items.description: Transurban head of cyber defense Muhammad Ali Paracha shares how his team is automating the triaging and scoring of security threats as part of the Black Hat Middle East conference.

items.title: CISA and NSA Warn of BRICKSTORM Malware Attacking VMware ESXi and Windows Environments
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the National Security Agency (NSA), and the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre) issued a joint advisory today, warning of a sophisticated new malware campaign orchestrated by People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber actors.
